1_paper_baseline_reproduction.conclusion: Successfully reproduced the historical paper's metrics (~0.643 accuracy, ~0.456 F1) on clean data. XGBoost correctly matches within tolerance (~0.625).

2_leakage_sensitivity_study.finding: Data leakage heavily inflates performance. Failing to deduplicate track_ids across genres inflates accuracy to ~0.75, and duplicating the dataset (2x append) inflates it to ~0.92.
